questions.q: Do you work with video podcasts?
questions.a: Yes. You get back a mix that is exactly the same length as your recording, plus one cleaned track per speaker, so automatic camera switching and clip tools keep working.
The recording before any enhancement or automatic leveling, with each speaker on a separate track if your software allows it.

questions.q: I already edit my own episodes. Can you just mix them?
questions.a: Yes. Send your edited file and I'll mix and master it without changing your cuts.
